title: HOTU 98.2% rests only on the uncalibrated network fit; every cross-check reads lower
detail: Fixture 1082792 (HOTU vs The Huns, Moscow Cyber Games 2026, 2026-10-31) is published at HOTU 98.2% / The Huns 1.8% from the project's own bo3.gg network model. Independent reads on 2026-10-25 (data/research/27ac20d6/research.json): HLTV ranks the teams #38 vs #134 and resolves The Huns to VRS #122; replaying the project's Valve model (RD 75) on the committed 2026-10-05 points gives HOTU 94.1% against that roster (98.4% against the weaker same-name roster); the Polymarket book for the fixture exists but is 43 cents wide (rejected by the project's own 0.15 ceiling; best asks 92c/53c on $690 at 14:40Z are not probabilities); EGamersWorld shows a 1.8/1.8 placeholder. Pick direction (HOTU) is unanimous; only the magnitude is single-sourced. The published figure is left untouched for review; the 4-hour ladder will replace it automatically if a usable market line appears before 31 Oct.

title: The bo3.gg 'rating' source links on the 1082792 card return 404
detail: The published origination card for 1082792 links 'HOTU rating' to https://bo3.gg/teams/2720 and 'The Huns rating' to https://bo3.gg/teams/9127. Both returned bo3.gg's '404 Page not found' body when read at 2026-10-25T14:47Z, and no fixture page exists at the canonical slug bo3.gg/matches/hotu-vs-the-huns-31-10-2026. The underlying model inputs are pipeline-captured evidence, so the estimate's provenance inside the repo is intact, but a reader following the card's own links cannot verify the number at the source. Fix belongs to the link builder in scripts/originate.py (bo3.gg team route changed); logged as a change request in COORDINATION.md, not edited by this session.

title: The Huns' VRS identity is resolvable from HLTV, but not by the ladder's exact-five rule
detail: The featured ladder leaves 1082792's Valve rung unresolved because two Valve rows share the name 'The Huns' (#122, 944 pts; #213, 701 pts in the 2026-10-05 standings). HLTV's match page lists the event lineup Bart4k/controlez/bexyz/Cozen/DarkMeister - 4 of 5 of the #122 core, 2 of 5 of #213 - and HLTV's own VRS link for team 12510 resolves to #122. A future rung that disambiguates by majority core overlap against a sourced event lineup could take the Valve estimate here; under the current strict exact-five rule the refusal is correct. Recorded as a change request, with the full read in data/research/27ac20d6/research.json.

title: LFO 10's Valve blocker was a standings-vintage artifact; the team is now VRS-listed
detail: Fixture 1081156's raw-snapshot blocker ('LFO 10: no exact-name Valve rating found') reproduces exactly against the committed 2026-10-05 standings (LFO 7/8/9 present, LFO 10 absent). HLTV's team page (team 14084, Sweden; core dottie/flaw/Sapec, each 10 days on the team at 2026-10-25) shows the core formed after that file, and HLTV's 2026-10-25 VRS mirror already lists LFO 10 at #156. A refresh using a newer standings file should resolve the name exactly; no alias or model change is needed. The published pick (4-source money consensus via Sokerorg -> LFO 10) is unaffected.

title: Bookmaker rows link to the generic Thunderpick API endpoint, not a verifiable match page
detail: The glance source link for both Thunderpick rows is https://thunderpick.io/api/matches (a live generic endpoint), and the committed data/evidence/thunderpick-matches.json capture predates the two fixtures. The durable record of the observed lines (1.60/2.20 for 1082859, 1.001/12.00 for 1082860) is the quote block on each origination card. A reader cannot re-derive either line from the published link alone after the market closes; noted as a verifiability limitation, not a data error.
